WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision OFFSET 0) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision OFFSET 0) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rfv_num v WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.record_id = r.id AND v.field_id = $8::uuid AND v.value = $9::double precision OFFSET 0) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

### (b) A1-6 (3) anti-correlated 2% (8,000 oldest), a6

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

### (b)+group broad 50% (200,000), a6

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC

(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.spike_pk = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10

ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
